question: A 1:16 model ship must move like a real one. By the square-root rule, how many frames a second should a 24-frame camera run?
move: When size shrinks, time shrinks by less; check the rule before scaling.
trap: Running 16 times faster, as if time shrank with size.
hint: Gravity sets the pace: a fall takes time in proportion to the square root of its height.
steps: Motion under gravity speeds up by the square root of the scale.
reference: Fielding, The Technique of Special Effects Cinematography, 4th edn, Focal Press, 1985
